Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1983
CIVIL PIONEER FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Civil Pioneer Force (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 12, Ordinance XXVII of 1965

ORDINANCE XXX OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXX OF 1983
CIVIL PIONEER FORCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Civil Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 12, Ordinance XXVII of 1965.--In the Civil
Pioneer Force Ordinance, 1965 (XXVII of 1-965), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, in section 12, for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely :-
"Provided
that offences under clause (a) shall be tried under the Prohibi tion
(Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979 (P. O. No. 4 of 1979)".

Amendment of sections 14, 15 and 16, Ordinance XXVII of 1963

the said Ordinance, in sections 14, 15 and 16, after the figure and comma
"12,", the words, brackets, letter and comma "except clause (a)
thereof," shall be inserted.
